column1: # Martin AR et al. (2017) Human demographic history impacts genetic risk prediction across diverse populations.
# Am J Hum Genet 100:635-649. doi:10.1016/j.ajhg.2017.03.004. Main text p. 639:
# "when compared to the ASW, the ACB have a higher proportion of African ancestry (m = 0.88, 95% CI = [0.87-0.89]
#  versus m = 0.76, 95% CI = [0.73-0.78]) ... The PEL have more NAT ancestry than all of the other AMR populations
#  and MXL: m = 0.47, 95% CI = [0.43, 0.50])". ADMIXTURE K=3 with YRI, CEU and NAT references (Figure 1A, Table S2);
# RFMix global ancestry agreed with ADMIXTURE K=5 (Pearson r >= 98%, Figure S4). 1000 Genomes Phase 3 samples.
